title: Exact Dynamic Programming for Solow--Polasky Diversity Subset Selection on Lines and Staircases
summary: This paper studies exact fixed-cardinality Solow--Polasky diversity subset selection on ordered finite $\ell_1$ point sets, with monotone biobjective Pareto fronts and their higher-dimensional staircase analogues as central applications.
